AGENDA

OCTOBER 24, 2017
07:00

ROLL CALL
COUNCIL/AGENCY MEMBERS: Munoz, Lewis, Argudo, Holloway and Solis
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
Introduction of LEAD Students Attending the City Council Meeting
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council - Successor Agency on an item other than a closed session and public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843.)
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS OF SEPTEMBER 28, 2017, AND OCTOBER 10, 2017
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meetings of September 28, 2017, and October 10, 2017.
A-1 Minutes 9-28-17 CC
A-1 Minutes 10-10-17 CC-SA
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL â€“ None
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
UPDATE ON THE STATUS OF THE CITYâ€™S EMERGENCY PREPAREDNESS PLANS
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the update.
C-1 Emergency Plans Update Staff Report
C-1 Emergency Plans Update Attachment A Hazard Mitigation Plan
C-1 Emergency Plans Update Attachment B Emergency Ops Plan
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTIONS APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NOS. 1439 AND 53
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency adopt Resolution No. 17-5371 approving Warrant Register No. 1439 and Resolution No. SA 17-77 approving Warrant Register No. 53.
D-1 Warrants Resolution #1439
D-1 Warrants Resolution SA #53
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF REJECTION OF ALL BIDS FOR THE BUS SHELTER AND BUS BENCH COATING PROJECT
It is recommended that the City Council reject all bids for the Bus Shelter and Bus Bench Coating project.
D-2 Bus Shelter and Bus Bench Coating Bid Rejection Staff Report
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF AWARD OF CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT TO SULLY-MILLER CONTRACTING CO. FOR THE LOCAL STREETS AND CITY PARK IMPROVEMENT PROJECT IN THE AMOUNT OF $758,173
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) award the contract to Sully-Miller Contracting Co. in the amount of 758,173; (2) authorize the City Manager to approve change orders up to 10% of the original bid amount; and (3) authorize the appropriation of $12,000 of Measure R Funds and $170,305 of Lighting and Landscape Maintenance Funds from available fund balance.
D-3 Sully Miller Local Streets and Park Imp Staff Report
D-3 Sully Miller Local Streets and Park Imps Attachment A Agreement
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO THE PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH E & L LANDSCAPE SERVICES TO ADD ADDITIONAL WORK, AND INCREASING THE RATES BY FOUR PERCENT COMMENCING ON JANUARY 1, 2018
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve Amendment No. 1 to the Professional Services with E & L Landscape Services in the amount of $5,000.00; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the amendment on behalf of the City.
D-4 E&L Landscape Amendment Staff Report
D-4 E&L Landscape Amendment Attachment A Amendment
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF A MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING (â€œMOUâ€) WITH THE CITY OF INDUSTRY FOR RECONSTRUCTION AND STREET IMPROVEMENTS TO VALLEY BOULEVARD
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the MOU; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the MOU on behalf of the City.
D-5 Valley Wall MOU Staff Report
D-5 Valley Wall MOU Attachment A MOU
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF A JOINT EXERCISE OF POWERS AGREEMENT WITH THE CALIFORNIA HOME FINANCE AUTHORITY AND RESOLUTIONS CONSENTING TO THE INCLUSION OF PROPERTIES IN THE GOLDEN STATE FINANCE AUTHORITY PACE PROGRAM TO FINANCE RENEWABLE ENERGY AND ENERGY EFFICIENCY IMPROVEMENTS FOR PROPERTIES LOCATED IN THE CITY
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) adopt Resolution No. 17-5372 consenting to Inclusion of Properties within the City's Incorporated Area in GSFA Community Facilities District No. 2014-1 (Clean Energy) to Finance Renewable Energy Generation, Energy Efficiency, Water Conservation and Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure Improvements and approving associate membership in GSFA; and (2) adopt Resolution No. 17-5373 consenting to Inclusion of Properties within the City's Incorporated Area in the GSFA PACE Program to Finance Renewable Energy Generation, Energy and Water Efficiency Improvements and Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure and approving associate membership in GSFA.
E-1 Pace Program JPA Staff Report
E-1 Pace Program JPA Attachment A Resolution 17-5372 CDF
E-1 Pace Program JPA Attachment B Resolution 17-5373 PACE
E-1 Pace Program JPA Attachment C Agreement
ADHOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
AB 1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
